brief:
Israeli settlers wounded Palestinian photojournalist Alaa Badarneh during an attack south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. Details of Badarneh's injuries and the circumstances of the assault were not immediately disclosed.

The incident adds to a documented pattern of violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians and members of the press in occupied territories, where journalists covering unrest have faced repeated threats and physical harm.
